月が陰る。
強い風に煽られた雲が、白い月を隠している。

pages.en:
The moon dims.

Clouds driven by a violent wind sweep across its white face.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The moon darkens.
The clouds, blown by the strong wind, hide the white moon.

pages.ja:
桜に気付かれないよう外に出る。
時刻は午後十時
早い時間に巡回を始めたのは、昨夜の遅れを取り戻す為だった。

pages.en:
I slip outside without alerting Sakura.

It is ten o'clock. We have begun our patrol early to make up for last night's delay.
pages.mirrorMoon:
We go outside, careful not to wake Sakura.
It’s eleven o’clock
we decided to start patrolling earlier to make up for yesterday.

pages.ja:
キャスターを倒し、安心した油断をついて新たな被害が拡がったのだ。
キャスターが生きていて、今夜もその手を伸ばすというのなら、今度こそ決着をつけなくてはならない。

pages.en:
We defeated Caster and let down our guard, allowing new victims to fall.

If Caster truly is alive and means to reach out again tonight, we must settle matters once and for all.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The town has continued to suffer while my guard was down after Caster’s defeat.
If Caster is still alive and collecting energy from people, I have to defeat her for sure tonight.

問題はこれから何処に向かうかなのだが

“——Shirou. I sense a Servant.”

“…! Is it close, Saber?”

“The distance presents no difficulty. Even allowing for your speed, we can overtake it in roughly five minutes if we pursue at once with all our strength.

“——Your orders, Master.”

“
Shirou. I feel a Servant’s presence.”
“…! Is it close, Saber?”
“It should not be a problem distance-wise. Even with your speed, we should be able to catch up to the Servant in about five minutes.
Please give me an order, Master.”

追うか様子を見るか、その選択をセイバーは求めている。
が、そんなの考えるまでもない。

pages.en:
Saber asks me to choose: pursue it, or wait and observe.

But there is no choice to make.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Saber is asking me if we should follow them or stay here and keep watch.
I don’t even need to think about it.

pages.ja:
「行くぞ。先導してくれセイバー」
走り出すセイバー。
その方角は東
深山町と新都を繋ぐ大橋に向かっているようだった。

“We're going. Lead the way, Saber.”

Saber breaks into a run.

She leads us east, apparently toward the great bridge connecting Miyama and Shinto.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Let’s go. Lead the way, Saber.”
Saber starts to run.
She heads east

pages.ja:
「っ…………！」
公園に踏み入った瞬間、異様な気配に吐き気がした。
空気が濁っている。
鼻をつく異臭は、何かが腐り落ちる時のものだ。

pages.en:
“——!”

The instant I enter the park, an unnatural presence turns my stomach.

The air itself is foul.

An acrid stench fills my nose——the smell of something rotting away.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……!”
The instant I step into the park, the abnormal presence makes me feel like vomiting.
The air is polluted here.
The stench of rot and decay seeps into my nose.

pages.ja:
「う……、つ」
此処にいるだけで胃液が逆流する。
軽い目眩と、喉元の不快感に意識が割れかける。

“Urk…”

Merely standing here sends bile climbing into my throat.

Dizziness and the revulsion in my throat threaten to split my concentration apart.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Uh… guh.”
My gastric juice is regurgitated just by standing here.
The discomfort and the dizziness almost break my mind.

Dozens of tiny, indistinguishable things lie scattered at Tohsaka's feet.

Several times as many surround her Servant, Archer.

Zouken Matou must have attacked them using some form of magecraft.

“Ah. Saber's Master, unless my eyes deceive me.

“Well, well. To think the Tohsaka girl possessed the wit to arrange reinforcements.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hm. Well, if it isn’t Saber’s Master.
So you’ve prepared a backup? For Tohsaka’s daughter, you are surprisingly smart.”

pages.ja:

あそこにいるのはただの観客、わたしとは関係ないんだから」

pages.en:
“Don't be absurd. Archer and I are more than enough to pin you down and make you confess.

“Those two are merely spectators. They have nothing to do with me.”

Tohsaka never turns toward us. Her gaze remains fixed entirely upon Zouken Matou.

“You’re wrong. Archer and I are more than enough to beat a confession out of you.

“What were you thinking, coming at a time like this!? Do you want to die!?”

“…I know. This is no time to quarrel with Tohsaka.”

Just as Tohsaka refuses to take her eyes from Zouken Matou, I cannot ignore the danger I sense in the old man.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shirou.”
“…I know. This isn’t the time to be arguing with Tohsaka.”

慎二をマスターにして、聖杯を得ようとしたマキリの末裔。
そんなヤツが、大人しくこの戦いを傍観する訳がないんだから。

pages.en:
…A monster said to have survived by drinking human blood.

A descendant of Makiri who tried to obtain the Holy Grail by making Shinji a Master.

There is no possibility that such a creature would quietly stand aside and watch this war.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…A monster said to have survived by sucking people’s blood.
A descendant of Makiri who tried to obtain the Holy Grail and made Shinji into a Master.
There’s no way such a guy would just stand there and not do anything.

“Caster…! Damn, so she really is still alive…!”
“Please stay back, Shirou. That is Caster, but not Caster. …Her appearance and abilities are the same, but I do not feel her will or her soul.

“Oh. As expected from Saber. You saw through my trick right away. Oh my, no wonder Shinji’s Rider was no match for you.
Archer should not be a match against you, just like Caster, who was defeated without being able to do anything.”

Even though Caster is our enemy, she is a heroic spirit chosen as a Servant. You better have an appropriate determination if you are trifling with her corpse.”

ならば

“Answer for it? I merely retrieved something that no longer had an owner.

“Call me depraved if you wish, Saber. But the fate awaiting you will be fouler still.

“For yours is the body of the finest Servant.

“Rather than this wretched corpse, nothing would please me more than to subjugate you. I shall feed your flesh to my insects and grant you the same destiny as the husk beside me.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh. I only picked up some trash that nobody needed any longer.
I do not mind being called a heretic for that, but you would fall lower than a brute if that is the case.
You are the greatest Servant, after all.
Then it is best to make
you, rather than this corpse, into my slave.
you submit to me, rather than this corpse.

「貴様」
「カカカ、何を憤る！ 所詮サーヴァントなど主の道具、どのように使役するかなど問題ではあるまい！ 令呪で縛られるも死してなお使われるも同じ、ならば心ない人形と化すがうぬらの為であろう！」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“You——”

“Kakaka! Why such anger? A Servant is no more than a tool belonging to its Master. What difference does the manner of its use make? Whether bound by Command Spells in life or put to work after death, you are enslaved just the same. Surely becoming a mindless doll would be the kinder fate!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“You.”
“Kakaka, why are you enraged!? Servants are merely tools! It does not matter how they are used! It is the same whether you bind them with a Command Spell or if you use them as a corpse! Then is it not for your sake to turn you into a mindless puppet!?”

pages.ja:
二人のサーヴァントが地を蹴る。

pages.en:
The damp air freezes in an instant.

My heart beats loudly, yet its rhythm is slowing.

Something evil is nearby.

I have to run.

I must not become involved with it.

My body understands this more deeply than my mind, yet it refuses the command to flee.
